title: Luhn Checksum
prompt: Implement the Luhn algorithm to validate digit strings. Normalize input by stripping spaces and hyphens before validation. luhn_valid(digits) returns true iff the (normalized) string is non-empty, consists only of digits, and passes the Luhn checksum. Doubling proceeds from the rightmost digit leftward (every second digit doubled; if doubled value > 9, subtract 9).
